questions.emi_instruction: The following scenarios describe contraventions of an article of the Human Rights Act. Match each scenario with the article it contravenes.
questions.question_text:
A young woman
with suicidal ideation is admitted to the ward and not observed or made contact with for two hours after admission. She is later discovered
to have hanged herself
questions.explanation:
The right to private/family life includes issues arising about family visits, home leaves, restricting correspondences, and prohibiting activities
such as smoking in care homes.  

The right to a fair hearing cannot be interfered with under any circumstance. Applications must be made to mental health tribunals and
Court of Protection.
The prohibition of torture comprises any act that is inhuman or degrading. These issues are most likely to arise with seclusion and
detentions.
The state has a duty to protect lives. All deaths occurring in state detention must be investigated, including suicides. It applies to both formal
and informal patients.

questions.emi_instruction: Identify one correct option for each of the following preventive measures in schizophrenia
questions.question_text:
Targeting pregnant women addressing low birth weight to diminish the burden
of schizophrenia
questions.explanation:
Universal prevention/interventions are directed to a general population group. Some epidemiological factors for schizophrenia
such as urban living, poor social capital including low social cohesion, exclusion and discrimination, low socioeconomic status are so
widespread that their targeting can be considered a universal intervention. Increasing social capital, decreasing discrimination and reducing
poverty are possible goals of universal intervention Indicated interventions target high-risk individuals with minimal but detectable signs or
symptoms foreshadowing mental disorder, but who do not meet diagnostic levels. E.g Identi�cation of a preschizophrenic state/prodrome
of schizophrenia. Selective interventions are targeted to individuals or subgroups whose risk of developing disorder is signi�cantly higher
than average. Perinatal complications and cannabis use have stimulated interest a putative risk factors for schizophrenia. Perinatal
complications such as low birth weight, hypoxic events during delivery, small for gestational age and premature rupture of membranes.
Cannabis has been strongly debated in the etiology of schizophrenia. The pooled estimate for development of psychosis associated with
prior cannabis use is an odds ratio of 2.1.
